# ataila_dgx_clusters (Data Source)

The DGX clusters as recorded (AI Center, read-only). The read does not converge a cluster that is forming or breaking.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_dgx_clusters" "all" {}

output "clusters" {
  value = [for c in data.ataila_dgx_clusters.all.clusters : "${c.name}: ${c.status}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only the cluster with this name.

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (List of Object) The clusters, by name: `id`, `name`, `topology`, `interconnect`, `members`, `crosslink_subnet`, `status`, `serve`, `error_message`, `notes`, `created_at`, `updated_at`. `members`: `hostname`, `role`, `crosslink_ip`, `mgmt_ip`; `serve`: `recipe`, `model`, `served_at`; times RFC 3339 in UTC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
